{props.title} {props.children}
export function ButtonGroupLab() { let $marks = new Set(["Kalın"]) let $saved = 0 const toggle = (m: string) => { const n = new Set($marks); n.has(m) ? n.delete(m) : n.add(m); $marks = n } const marks = [["Kalın", bold], ["Eğik", italic], ["Üstü çizili", strikethrough]] as const return
`Biçim: ${[...$marks].join(", ") || "yok"}`} class="lab-marks"> {marks.map(([name, icon]) => )} {["Başa", "Ortaya", "Sona"].map((x) => )}
}
